scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game (original with hook off vs candidate with hook on, hooked in CGame::Process), 4608 isolated CPU pairs for the 8 functions, zero differences, natural completion event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Fake objects with 16-byte guards on each side (compared whole); the return value (AL only; high EAX bytes are stack garbage in the EXE), the ordered trace of outgoing calls with raw arguments, the x87 control word (24-bit precision during the call) and every fixture byte are compared; the hook jump state (JumpsToDll) is checked after State(candidate). Only real globals touched: CWorld::Players (0x320 bytes), PlayerInFocus and the six CTimeCycle shadow arrays (+ index); saved at start, restored after each run and rechecked at the end. Traced stubs, patched at the EXE address, at the DLL symbol and at the DLL body (bodies computed before patching), so these helpers get NO credit: CCamera::IsExtraEntityToIgnore, CEntity::GetColModel, CPlaceable::AllocateMatrix, CSimpleTransform::UpdateMatrix, CCollision::CalculateTrianglePlanes/TestSphereBox/TestSphereTriangle (scripted results), CPed::operator new, CPlayerPed::CPlayerPed, CPlaceable::SetOrientation, CWorld::Add, CPedGeometryAnalyser::CanPedTargetPoint, ComputeEntityBoundingBoxCornersUncached and ComputeClosestSurfacePoint (rect), CRealTimeShadowManager::ReInit and GetRealTimeShadow, CRealTimeShadow::Create/Destroy/Update, CShadowCamera::Create/Destroy/MakeGradientRaster, CShadows::StoreRealTimeShadow and Fx_c::GetFxQuality; the game operator new/delete (0x82119A/0x8214BD) are replaced only during Init and Exit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Floats: no signalling NaN, magnitudes <= 3e14 (x87 keeps the extended exponent in sums of squares, SSE does not). Bench-own bug fixed before the approved run: the EntryPatch loop computed bodies after patching (stub patched with a jump to itself); bodies are now computed first. Excluded: SetupPlayerPed with playerId = -1 (the EXE indexes Players[-1], foreign memory), only ids 0 and 1 with PlayerInFocus 0/1. Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation.

function_scope.CCollision::SphereVsEntity: Corpus 1024: the EXE ignores its sphere parameter and tests an uninitialised local CColSphere, i.e. 16 stack bytes at [S-0x68, S-0x59]; a naked bridge (CallSve) writes a 16-byte seed there (finite/NaN/infinite) while the real sphere argument is a NaN decoy that must be ignored; the source captures the same 16 bytes in a naked bridge before any push. Entity using collision / IsExtraEntityToIgnore, matrix present or created via AllocateMatrix+UpdateMatrix, model with and without data, 0..3 spheres/boxes, 0..4 triangles with and without face groups, negative counters (0xFFFF, 0x8000, 0xFFFFFFFF); TestSphere* and CalculateTrianglePlanes are scripted traced stubs.
